name: CC MEETING - SEPTEMBER 4, 2018 - 7PM
agenda_text:
CC MEETING - SEPTEMBER 4, 2018 - 7PM
CC MEETING - SEPTEMBER 4, 2018 - 7PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 04, 2018
07:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 1435
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
3. ROLL CALL: MAYOR LEDFORD, MAYOR PRO TEM CARRILLO, COUNCILMEMBERS HOFBAUER, BETTENCOURT, AND BISHOP
4. PRESENTATIONS:
4.1 Palmdale Animal Care Center representative will present a cute critter that is available for adoption from our local Animal Care Center.
4.2 Presentation by Mayor and Council of a Proclamation to the Daughters of the American Revolution proclaiming the week of September 17th through September 23rd as Constitution Week.
4.3 Presentation by Mayor and Council of Certificates of Recognition to the recipients of the County Sanitation District of Los Angeles Certificate of Recognition Program:
• D & J Printing, Inc. DBA Bang Printing (First year of compliance)
• Lockheed Martin Corporation - Plant 10 (First year of compliance)
• Lockheed Martin Corporation - Site 2 (Sixteen years of compliance)
• Northrop Grumman Corporation – Site 7 (First year of compliance)
• Northrop Grumman Systems Corporation – Aerospace Systems – Site 3 (two years of compliance)
• Northrop Grumman Systems Corporation – Aerospace Systems Sector – Site 4 (first year of compliance)
4.4 Presentation by Mayor and Council of Certificates of Recognition to the visiting class from Colegio Maria Alvarado, Lima, Peru welcoming them to the City of Palmdale.
Students:
• Sebastian Alejandro Chuctaya Alvarez
• Andrea Mercedes Gil Diaz
• André Nicolás Orihuela Roldán
• Margiori Guissepina Delgado Enciso
• Rosa Maria Huamán Castilla
• Eduardo Samuel José Rosales Sanchez
• Teacher: Elizabeth Castro Davalos
5. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S) and ORDINANCE(S):
Staff Recommendation: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) and/or Ordinance(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting. (Vote - Requires a majority to waive.)
6. CONSENT CALENDAR – PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
7. CONSENT CALENDAR:
7.1 Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the City of Palmdale’s books as of July 31, 2018. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.1
7.2 ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-062, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, DECLARING A NEW CPI (COST PRICE INDEX) TO BE USED FOR RATE CALCULATION FOR THE COMMUNITY FACILITIES DISTRICT NO. 16-1 (JOSHUA RANCH WATER SUPPLY AND MAINTENANCE SERVICES). (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.2
7.3 Approve agreement for financial advisory services for the City of Palmdale, Housing Authority, or Successor Agency with Harrell & Company Advisors, LLC in an amount not to exceed $125,000 for a 5-year term, funded through multiple accounts, Agreement No. A-6347. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.3
7.4 Approve agreement with NBS Government Finance Group to provide Assessment District Administration, Community Facilities Administration and other related consulting services in an amount not to exceed $750,000 for a 3-year term commencing July 1, 2018 with the option to extend the Contract for two additional one year terms each, funded through multiple accounts, Agreement No. A-6346. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.4
7.5 Authorize travel expenditures for Mayor Pro Tem Juan Carrillo and Councilmember Steve Hofbauer to travel to Coronado Island, California to attend the California Contract Cities Association 38th Annual Fall Educational Summit on October 5 – 7, 2018, funded through Accounts 10110001-710010 and 10110001-710003, respectfully. (Staff Reference: City Manager Purtee)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.5
7.6 ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-064, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AMENDING THE CITY’S CLASSIFICATION AND PAY PLAN FOR GENERAL POSITIONS. (Staff Reference: Human Resources Manager Nevarez)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.6
7.7 Approve an agreement for Legal Services with Silver & Wright LLP, for a 3-year period, Agreement No. A-6400. (Staff Reference: City Attorney Ditzhazy)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.7
7.8 Authorize one (1) new Community Compliance Specialist to the Neighborhood Services Department, Neighborhood Compliance Division, to be funded by the Law Enforcement Tobacco Department of Justice Grant. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.8
7.9 Approve the amended and restated Memorandum of Understanding of Antelope Valley Regional Water Management Group and Integrated Regional Water Management Plan (IRWMP) Cost Sharing Agreement, funded through Account No. 10131004-721911, Agreement No. A-6389. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.9
7.10 Approve the minutes from the previous meetings held August 7, 2018 (5pm), and August 7, 2018 (7pm). (Staff Reference: City Clerk Smith)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.10
7.11 Approve a Professional Services Agreement with Ring LLC for the Ring Doorbell and Camera Rebate Program in the amount of $50,000, funded through Account No. 10125008-721963, and authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute the agreement, Agreement No. A-6410. (Staff Reference: City Manager Purtee)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.11
7.12 ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-069, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE IN SUPPORT OF REAUTHORIZING OF AND FULL FUNDING FOR THE LAND AND WATER CONSERVATION FUND. (Staff Reference: City Manager Purtee)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.12
7.13 Approve Purchase Order No. 20190249 with Intervision Systems Technologies, Inc. for Storage Area Network System (SANS) support and maintenance in the amount of $52,767 for a 12-month period, and authorize the City Manager to approve annual purchase orders for the ongoing service. (Staff Reference: Director of Administrative Services Ambrose)
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under this Consent Calendar. (Vote - Requires a majority to approve.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.13
8. APPOINTMENTS:
8.1 Mayor's nomination, Council approval, and appointment of John Manning as Library Board Trustee to fill a term expiring on June 30, 2019. (Staff Reference: City Clerk Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Move to appoint John Manning to the Library Board of Trustees to fill a term expiring on June 30, 2019. (Vote – Requires a majority to appoint.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 8.1
8.2 Discussion and possible action regarding a second Alternate position for the Antelope Valley Transit Authority (AVTA). (Staff Reference: City Clerk Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Discuss and provide direction to staff. (Vote – Requires a majority to approve.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 8.2
9. PUBLIC HEARINGS:
9.1 Public hearing under the Tax and Equity Fiscal Responsibility Act (TEFRA) and review of proposed Resolution No. CC 2018-063. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
9.1a RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-063, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING OF THE ISSUANCE OF CHARTER SCHOOL REVENUE BONDS BY THE CALIFORNIA MUNICIPAL FINANCE AUTHORITY, IN ONE OR MORE SERIES IN AN AGGREGATE PRINCIPAL AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $40,000,000 FOR THE PURPOSE OF FINANCING AND/OR REFINANCING THE ACQUISITION, CONSTRUCTION, AND EQUIPPING OF EDUCATIONAL FACILITIES TO BE USED AS A CALIFORNIA PUBLIC CHARTER SCHOOL AND CERTAIN OTHER MATTERS RELATING THERETO. (FACILITIES TO BE OPERATED BY THE PALMDALE AEROSPACE ACADEMY.)
Staff Recommendation: Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote – Requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Resolution No. CC 2018-063. (Vote – Requires a majority vote of the total membership of the City Council to adopt.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 9.1
9.2 Public Hearing and review of proposed Resolution No. CC 2018-065. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
9.2a RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-065, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE DIRECTING THE EXECUTION OF A NOTICE OF CESSATION OF SPECIAL TAX – IMPROVEMENT AREA B OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE COMMUNITY FACILITIES DISTRICT NO. 2003-1 (ANAVERDE PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS).
Staff Recommendation: Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote – Requires a majority to close.) Consideration of Resolution No. CC 2018-065. (Vote – Requires a majority vote of the total membership of the City Council to adopt.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 9.2
9.3 Public Hearing to: 1) hear public comments; 2) review and approve the 2017-2018 Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report (CAPER); and 3) authorize the City Manager or his designee to make necessary changes and submit the report to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) by September 28, 2018 in compliance with U. S. Department of Housing and Urban Development Regulations. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
Staff Recommendation: Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote – Requires a majority to close.) Move to approve the recommendations and findings as listed in the staff report. (Vote – Requires a majority to approve.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 9.3 - 17-18 CAPER
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 9.3 - STAFF REPORT
9.4 Public Hearing and review of proposed Ordinance No. 1512 (Zoning Ordinance Amendment 18-001). (Staff Reference: Director of Economic & Community Development Oyler)
9.4a ORDINANCE 1512, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE PALMDALE MUNICIPAL CODE TO INCREASE THE ALLOWABLE BUILDING HEIGHT IN THE C-4 ZONE (ZOA 18-001).
Staff Recommendation: Move to introduce Ordinance No. 1512. (Vote – Requires a majority to introduce.) Mayor to Open Public Hearing and Receive Testimony
Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote – Requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Ordinance No. 1512. (Vote – Requires a majority vote of the total membership of the City Council to adopt.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 9.4
9.5 Public Hearing and review of proposed Ordinance No. 1510 (Zoning Ordinance Amendment 18-003). (Staff Reference: Director of Economic & Community Development Oyler)
9.5a ORDINANCE NO. 1510, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE PALMDALE MUNICIPAL CODE REGARDING PERSONAL STORAGE FACILITIES (ZOA 18-003).
Staff Recommendation: Move to introduce Ordinance No. 1510. (Vote – Requires a majority to introduce.) Mayor to Open Public Hearing and Receive Testimony
Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote – Requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Ordinance No. 1510. (Vote – Requires a majority vote of the total membership of the City Council to adopt.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 9.5
9.6 Public Hearing and review of proposed Ordinance No. 1513 (Specific Plan Amendment 18-001 ). (Staff Reference: Director of Economic & Community Development Oyler)
9.6a ORDINANCE NO. 1513, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE ANTELOPE VALLEY AUTO CENTER SPECIFIC PLAN TO MODIFY THE LANDSCAPING REQUIREMENTS AND SIGN STANDARDS FOR THE AUTO CENTER (SPA 18-001).
Staff Recommendation: Move to introduce Ordinance No. 1513. (Vote – Requires a majority to introduce.) Mayor to Open Public Hearing and Receive Testimony
Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote – Requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Ordinance No. 1513. (Vote – Requires a majority vote of the total membership of the City Council to adopt.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 9.6
9.7 Public Hearing and review of proposed Resolution No. CC 2018-061 (General Plan Amendment 18-004) and Ordinance No. 1511 (Zone Change 18-004). (Staff Reference: Director of Economic & Community Development Oyler)
9.7a RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-061, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE GENERAL PLAN LAND USE DESIGNATION FROM CC (COMMUNITY COMMERCIAL) TO PF (PUBLIC FACILITY) ON THREE VACANT PARCELS LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 1,300 FEET WEST OF 35TH STREET EAST, SOUTH OF PALMDALE BOULEVARD (APN’S 3020 004-020, 3020-004-038 AND 3020-004-093) (GPA 18-004).
9.7b ORDINANCE NO. 1511, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE CHANGING THE ZONE DESIGNATION FROM C-3 (GENERAL COMMERCIAL) TO PF (PUBLIC FACILITY) ON THREE VACANT PARCELS LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 1,300 FEET WEST OF 35TH STREET EAST, SOUTH OF PALMDALE BOULEVARD (APN’S 3020-004-020, 3020-004-038 AND 3020 004-093) (ZC 18-004).
Staff Recommendation: Move to introduce Ordinance No. 1511. (Vote – Requires a majority to introduce.) Mayor to Open Public Hearing and Receive Testimony
Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote – Requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Resolution No. CC 2018-061 and Ordinance No. 1511. (Vote – Requires a majority vote of the total membership of the City Council to adopt.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 9.7
10. NEW BUSINESS:
10.1 Discussion and possible action on Resolution No. CC 2018-067. (Staff Reference: City Manager Purtee)
10.1a RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-067, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE SUPPORTING EXTENSION OF THE TEMPORARY PROTECTED STATUS (TPS) PROGRAM.
Staff Recommendation: Discussion and consideration of Resolution No. CC 2018-067. (Vote – Requires a majority to adopt.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 10.1
11. SPECIAL REPORT:
11.1 Discussion and direction to staff regarding the draft report recalculating the Quality of Life Infrastructure Park Development Impact Fees. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Move to provide direction to staff regarding the draft report recalculating the Quality of Life Infrastructure Park Development Impact Fees. (Vote - Requires a majority to approve.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 11.1
12. JOINT SPECIAL REPORT CITY COUNCIL ITEM 12.1 and SUCCESSOR AGENCY ITEM 5.1:
12.1 Discussion and possible action regarding the cancellation of the Regularly Scheduled Meetings of the City Council and the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdale scheduled for Tuesday, November 6, 2018 at 7:00 p.m. (Staff Reference: City Clerk/Agency Secretary Smith)
Call for Public Comments
Staff Recommendation: Move to provide direction to City Clerk/Agency Secretary regarding the November 6, 2018 City Council/Successor Agency meetings. (Vote - Requires a majority to approve.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 12.1
13. NON-AGENDA ITEMS – PUBLIC COMMENTS:
14. INFORMATIONAL REPORT FROM MAYOR AND / OR COUNCILMEMBERS ON THEIR VARIOUS COMMITTEE MEMBERSHIPS AND MEETINGS ATTENDED AT PUBLIC EXPENSE.
15. CITY COUNCIL REQUESTS FOR NEW AGENDA ITEMS.
16. ADJOURNMENT.
